saturation_history.rationale: All relevant open codes are already absorbed by existing dimensions. The payment-provider codes map directly to Dimension 6 (Payment Provider Integration). The verification-token code is covered by Dimension 2 (Verification Token Lifecycle). The rental lifecycle and scheduler codes fit Dimension 3 (Rental Workflow Coordination), while the real-time bike status, usage analytics, and operational visibility codes are covered by Dimensions 4 and 5 (Real-Time Status Communication and Operational Monitoring/Analytics). The logout/session and authentication/credential-protection codes are covered by Dimension 1 (Identity and Session Security). No open code introduces a distinct architectural concern that is not already represented in the taxonomy for the CityBike use case.

All relevant open codes are already subsumed by existing dimensions. Biometric thumbprint authentication and inactivity-based auto-logout map to Authentication and Session Security; biometric deletion, end-to-end encryption, encryption of transmission/storage, registration-data scope, and registration security/compliance map to Data Protection and Privacy; OTP generation/delivery and 30-minute validity map to Verification Token Lifecycle; location-based availability lookup and bike location management map to Bike Location Tracking; observer-based availability updates map to Real-Time Status Communication; and state-machine rental flow, navigation, QR unlock, and lifecycle tracking map to Rental Workflow Coordination. The minibatch does not reveal a distinct architectural concern outside the current taxonomy, so the taxonomy is saturated for this batch.
